description: Test what you learned in Unit 2

questions.question: It is your first day at a new job. Your manager asks you to introduce yourself to the team. What is the best opening sentence?
options: Hello everyone, my name is Faadumo and I'm the new receptionist.
Can someone tell me what to do?
Nice to meet you, I think.
questions.explanation: A professional introduction includes a greeting, your name, and your role.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses 'work' as a noun?
options: He goes to work by bus every morning.
questions.explanation: In 'goes to work', 'work' is a noun referring to the workplace or job. In the other options, 'work' is used as a verb.

questions.statement: The word 'occupation' is another word for a person's job or profession.
questions.explanation: 'Occupation' is a formal synonym for 'job' or 'profession', often used on official forms.

questions.statement: You should always use someone's first name when meeting them professionally for the first time.
questions.explanation: In many professional contexts, it is more respectful to use 'Mr.' or 'Ms.' and their surname until invited to use first names.

questions.sentence: She is a nurse. She ___ at City Hospital from Monday to Friday.
questions.explanation: 'Works' is the correct third-person singular present tense verb here.

questions.sentence: He is ___ charge of training new staff — he is the training manager.
questions.explanation: 'In charge of' means responsible for managing something.

questions.sentence: My uncle is a ___ — he drives patients to the hospital in an emergency vehicle.
questions.explanation: A paramedic or ambulance driver responds to emergencies and transports patients.

questions.question: Put these words in the correct order:
questions.explanation: 'What do you do?' is the standard English question asking about someone's job.

questions.instruction: Match each job title to the correct description.
questions.explanation: Each job title has a specific professional role associated with it.

questions.question: Writing Task
questions.prompt: Write 3-5 sentences introducing yourself to your new team on your first day at work.
questions.guidance: Include: your name, your new job title or role, and one thing you are looking forward to or a relevant skill you bring.
questions.example_answer: Hello everyone, my name is Asad and I am the new IT support technician. I have three years of experience fixing computers and setting up networks. I am really looking forward to working with all of you and learning how things are done here.

preview_questions.question: You are in a shop and want to know the cost of an item. What is the most natural question to ask?
preview_questions.explanation: 'How much does this cost?' is the standard question to ask about price in a shop.

preview_questions.question: A customer says 'I'd like to return this jacket.' What does 'return' mean here?
options: Bring back to the shop for a refund or exchange
preview_questions.explanation: To 'return' an item means to bring it back to the shop, usually for a refund or exchange.
